201        public void reportPlayerMarketTransaction(PlayerMarketTransaction transaction) {
202                if (!isParticipatesInEconomy()) return;
203                
204                PlayerEconomyImpactMode mode = getPlayerEconomyImpactMode();
205                //if (mode == PlayerEconomyImpactMode.NONE) return;
206                
207                //mode = PlayerEconomyImpactMode.NONE;
208                
209                SharedData.getData().getPlayerActivityTracker().getPlayerTradeData(submarket).addTransaction(transaction);
210                
211                
212                for (CargoStackAPI stack : transaction.getSold().getStacksCopy()) {
213                        if (stack.isCommodityStack()) {
214                                float qty = stack.getSize() * getPlayerTradeImpactMult();
215                                if (qty <= 0) continue;
216                                CommodityOnMarketAPI com = market.getCommodityData(stack.getCommodityId());
217                                
218                                if (mode == PlayerEconomyImpactMode.BOTH) {
219                                        com.addTradeMod("sell_" + Misc.genUID(), qty, TRADE_IMPACT_DAYS);
220                                } else if (mode == PlayerEconomyImpactMode.PLAYER_SELL_ONLY) {
221                                        com.addTradeModPlus("sell_" + Misc.genUID(), qty, TRADE_IMPACT_DAYS);
222                                } else if (mode == PlayerEconomyImpactMode.PLAYER_BUY_ONLY || mode == PlayerEconomyImpactMode.NONE) {
223                                        com.addTradeModMinus("sell_" + Misc.genUID(), qty, TRADE_IMPACT_DAYS);
224                                }
225                                
226                                float currQty = com.getCombinedTradeModQuantity();
227                                float origQty = Math.max(0f, currQty - qty);
228                                int origMod = (int) com.getModValueForQuantity(origQty);
229                                int currMod = (int) com.getModValueForQuantity(Math.min(origQty + com.getDeficitQuantity(), currQty));
230                                
231                                int modDiff = currMod - origMod;
232                                float remove = stack.getSize() * getTradeSellRemoveMult();
233                                if (modDiff > 0) {
234                                        float modVal = com.getQuantityForModValue(modDiff);
235                                        remove = modVal + Math.max(0f, (stack.getSize() - modVal) * getTradeSellRemoveMult());
236                                }
237                                if (remove > 0) {
238                                        getCargo().removeCommodity(com.getId(), remove);
239                                }
240                                
241                        }
242                }
243                for (CargoStackAPI stack : transaction.getBought().getStacksCopy()) {
244                        if (stack.isCommodityStack()) {
245                                float qty = stack.getSize() * getPlayerTradeImpactMult();
246                                if (qty <= 0) continue;
247                                CommodityOnMarketAPI com = market.getCommodityData(stack.getCommodityId());
248                                
249                                if (mode == PlayerEconomyImpactMode.BOTH) {
250                                        com.addTradeMod("buy_" + Misc.genUID(), -qty, TRADE_IMPACT_DAYS);
251                                } else if (mode == PlayerEconomyImpactMode.PLAYER_SELL_ONLY || mode == PlayerEconomyImpactMode.NONE) {
252                                        com.addTradeModPlus("buy_" + Misc.genUID(), -qty, TRADE_IMPACT_DAYS);
253                                } else if (mode == PlayerEconomyImpactMode.PLAYER_BUY_ONLY) {
254                                        com.addTradeModMinus("buy_" + Misc.genUID(), -qty, TRADE_IMPACT_DAYS);
255                                }
256                        }
257                }
258        }

342        protected void addWeapons(int min, int max, int maxTier, WeightedRandomPicker<String> factionPicker, boolean withCategories) {
343                WeightedRandomPicker<WeaponSpecAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<WeaponSpecAPI>(itemGenRandom);
344                
345                WeightedRandomPicker<WeaponSpecAPI> pd = new WeightedRandomPicker<WeaponSpecAPI>(itemGenRandom);
346                WeightedRandomPicker<WeaponSpecAPI> kinetic = new WeightedRandomPicker<WeaponSpecAPI>(itemGenRandom);
347                WeightedRandomPicker<WeaponSpecAPI> nonKinetic = new WeightedRandomPicker<WeaponSpecAPI>(itemGenRandom);
348                WeightedRandomPicker<WeaponSpecAPI> missile = new WeightedRandomPicker<WeaponSpecAPI>(itemGenRandom);
349                WeightedRandomPicker<WeaponSpecAPI> strike = new WeightedRandomPicker<WeaponSpecAPI>(itemGenRandom);
350
351                for (int i = 0; i < factionPicker.getItems().size(); i++) {
352                        String factionId = factionPicker.getItems().get(i);
353                        float w = factionPicker.getWeight(i);
354                        if (factionId == null) factionId = market.getFactionId();
355                
356                        float quality = Misc.getShipQuality(market, factionId);
357                        FactionAPI faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(factionId);
358                        
359                        for (String id : faction.getKnownWeapons()) {
360                                WeaponSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getWeaponSpec(id);
361                                if (spec.getTier() > maxTier) continue;
362                                if (spec.getAIHints().contains(AIHints.SYSTEM)) continue;
363                                if (spec.hasTag(Tags.WEAPON_NO_SELL)) continue;
364                                if (isBlackMarket() && spec.hasTag(Tags.NO_SELL_BLACK_MARKET)) continue;
365                                
366                                float p = DefaultFleetInflater.getTierProbability(spec.getTier(), quality);
367                                p = 1f; // 
368                                p *= w;
369                                if (faction.getWeaponSellFrequency().containsKey(id)) {
370                                        p *= faction.getWeaponSellFrequency().get(id);
371                                }
372                                picker.add(spec, p);
373                                
374                                String cat = spec.getAutofitCategory();
375                                if (cat != null && spec.getSize() != WeaponSize.LARGE) {
376                                        if (CoreAutofitPlugin.PD.equals(cat)) {
377                                                pd.add(spec, p);
378                                        } else if (CoreAutofitPlugin.STRIKE.equals(cat)) {
379                                                strike.add(spec, p);
380                                        } else if (CoreAutofitPlugin.KINETIC.equals(cat)) {
381                                                kinetic.add(spec, p);
382                                        } else if (CoreAutofitPlugin.MISSILE.equals(cat) || CoreAutofitPlugin.ROCKET.equals(cat)) {
383                                                missile.add(spec, p);
384                                        } else if (CoreAutofitPlugin.HE.equals(cat) || CoreAutofitPlugin.ENERGY.equals(cat)) {
385                                                nonKinetic.add(spec, p);
386                                        }
387                                }
388                        }
389                }
390                
391                int num = min + itemGenRandom.nextInt(max - min + 1);
392                num = getModifiedNum(num, true, "ext_weaponForSaleFraction");
393                
394                if (withCategories) {
395                        if (num > 0 && !pd.isEmpty()) {
396                                pickAndAddWeapons(pd);
397                                num--;
398                        }
399                        if (num > 0 && !kinetic.isEmpty()) {
400                                pickAndAddWeapons(kinetic);
401                                num--;
402                        }
403                        if (num > 0 && !missile.isEmpty()) {
404                                pickAndAddWeapons(missile);
405                                num--;
406                        }
407                        if (num > 0 && !nonKinetic.isEmpty()) {
408                                pickAndAddWeapons(nonKinetic);
409                                num--;
410                        }
411                        if (num > 0 && !strike.isEmpty()) {
412                                pickAndAddWeapons(strike);
413                                num--;
414                        }
415                }
416                
417
418                for (int i = 0; i < num && !picker.isEmpty(); i++) {
419                        pickAndAddWeapons(picker);
420                }
421        }
422        
423        protected int getModifiedNum(int num, boolean sqrt, String keepFractonSettingsId) {
424                float keepFraction = Misc.isExtended() ? Global.getSettings().getFloat(keepFractonSettingsId) : 1f;
425                if (keepFraction >= 1f) return num;
426                if (sqrt) keepFraction = (float) Math.sqrt(keepFraction);
427                if (keepFraction <= 0f) return 0;
428                
429                if (keepFraction < 1f) {
430                        float plusMinus = Math.max(1f, num * keepFraction * 0.25f);
431                        float modified = (num * keepFraction) + itemGenRandom.nextFloat() * plusMinus * 2f - plusMinus;
432                        if (modified < 1f) {
433                                if (itemGenRandom.nextFloat() < modified) {
434                                        modified = 1f;
435                                } else {
436                                        modified = 0f;
437                                }
438                        }
439                        //num = (int) Math.round(modified);
440                        num = (int) modified;
441                }
442                return num;
443        }

445        protected void pickAndAddWeapons(WeightedRandomPicker<WeaponSpecAPI> picker) {
446                WeaponSpecAPI spec = picker.pick();
447                if (spec == null) return;
448                
449//              int count = 2;
450//              switch (spec.getSize()) {
451//              case LARGE: count = 2; break;
452//              case MEDIUM: count = 4; break;
453//              case SMALL: count = 8; break;
454//              }
455//              count = count + itemGenRandom.nextInt(count + 1) - count/2;
456                
457                int count = 1;
458                switch (spec.getSize()) {
459                case LARGE: count = 1; break;
460                case MEDIUM: count = 2; break;
461                case SMALL: count = 3; break;
462                }
463                count = count + itemGenRandom.nextInt(count + 2) - itemGenRandom.nextInt(count + 1);
464                if (count < 1) count = 1;
465                
466                count = getModifiedNum(count, true, "ext_weaponForSaleFraction");
467                if (count > 0) {
468                        cargo.addWeapons(spec.getWeaponId(), count);
469                }
470        }

473        protected void addFighters(int min, int max, int maxTier, String factionId) {
474                if (factionId == null) factionId = market.getFactionId();
475                
476                int num = min + itemGenRandom.nextInt(max - min + 1);
477                num = getModifiedNum(num, true, "ext_fighterForSaleFraction");
478                
479                float quality = Misc.getShipQuality(market, factionId);
480                
481                FactionAPI faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(factionId);
482                
483                WeightedRandomPicker<FighterWingSpecAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<FighterWingSpecAPI>(itemGenRandom);
484                for (String id : faction.getKnownFighters()) {
485                        FighterWingSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getFighterWingSpec(id);
486                        if (spec == null) {
487                                throw new RuntimeException("Fighter wing spec with id [" + id + "] not found");
488                        }
489                        if (spec.getTier() > maxTier) continue;
490                        if (spec.hasTag(Tags.WING_NO_SELL)) continue;
491                        
492                        float p = DefaultFleetInflater.getTierProbability(spec.getTier(), quality);
493                        p = 1f;
494                        if (faction.getFighterSellFrequency().containsKey(id)) {
495                                p *= faction.getFighterSellFrequency().get(id);
496                        }
497                        picker.add(spec, p);
498                }
499                
500                for (int i = 0; i < num && !picker.isEmpty(); i++) {
501                        FighterWingSpecAPI spec = picker.pick();
502                        
503                        int count = 2;
504                        switch (spec.getRole()) {
505                        case ASSAULT: count = 2; break;
506                        case BOMBER: count = 2; break;
507                        case INTERCEPTOR: count = 4; break;
508                        case FIGHTER: count = 3; break;
509                        case SUPPORT: count = 2; break;
510                        }
511                        
512                        count = count + itemGenRandom.nextInt(count + 1) - count/2;
513                        count = getModifiedNum(count, true, "ext_fighterForSaleFraction");
514                        if (count > 0) {
515                                cargo.addItems(CargoItemType.FIGHTER_CHIP, spec.getId(), count);
516                        }
517                }
518        }
519        protected void pruneWeapons(float keepFraction) {
520                CargoAPI cargo = getCargo();
521                for (CargoStackAPI stack : cargo.getStacksCopy()) {
522                        if (stack.isWeaponStack() || stack.isFighterWingStack()) {
523                                float qty = stack.getSize();
524                                if (qty <= 1) {
525                                        if (itemGenRandom.nextFloat() > keepFraction) {
526                                                cargo.removeItems(stack.getType(), stack.getData(), 1);
527                                        }
528                                } else {
529                                        cargo.removeItems(stack.getType(), stack.getData(), Math.round(qty * (1f - keepFraction)));
530                                }
531                        }
532                }
533        }

565        public void addShips(String factionId, 
566                                                float combat,
567                                                float freighter,
568                                                float tanker,
569                                                float transport, 
570                                                float liner, 
571                                                float utility,
572                                                Float qualityOverride,
573                                                float qualityMod,
574                                                ShipPickMode modeOverride,
575                                                FactionDoctrineAPI doctrineOverride,
576                                                int minShipSize,
577                                                int maxShipSize) {
578                FleetParamsV3 params = new FleetParamsV3(
579                                market,
580                                Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getLocationInHyperspace(),
581                                factionId,
582                                null, // qualityOverride
583                                FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE,
584                                combat, // combatPts
585                                freighter, // freighterPts 
586                                tanker, // tankerPts
587                                transport, // transportPts
588                                liner, // linerPts
589                                utility, // utilityPts
590                                0f // qualityMod
591                                );
592                params.minShipSize = minShipSize;
593                params.maxShipSize = maxShipSize;
594                params.random = new Random(itemGenRandom.nextLong());
595                
596                if (Misc.isExtended()) {
597                        qualityMod += Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_shipForSaleQualityMod");
598                }
599                
600                params.qualityOverride = Misc.getShipQuality(market, factionId) + qualityMod;
601                if (qualityOverride != null) {
602                        params.qualityOverride = qualityOverride + qualityMod;
603                }
604                //params.qualityMod = qualityMod;
605                
606                params.withOfficers = false;
607                
608                params.forceAllowPhaseShipsEtc = true;
609                params.treatCombatFreighterSettingAsFraction = true;
610                
611                params.modeOverride = Misc.getShipPickMode(market, factionId);
612                if (modeOverride != null) {
613                        params.modeOverride = modeOverride;
614                }
615                
616                params.doctrineOverride = doctrineOverride;
617
618                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = FleetFactoryV3.createFleet(params);
619                if (fleet != null) {
620                        //float p = 0.5f;
621                        //p = 1f;
622                        
623                        float p = Misc.isExtended() ? Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_shipForSaleFraction") : 1f;
624                        WeightedRandomPicker<FleetMemberAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<>(itemGenRandom);
625                        FactionAPI faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(factionId);
626                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
627                                float f = 1f;
628                                if (faction != null) {
629                                        Float mult = faction.getFactionSpec().getShipSellFrequency().get(member.getHullId());
630                                        if (mult != null) {
631                                                f *= mult;
632                                        }
633                                }
634                                if (itemGenRandom.nextFloat() > f * 0.5f) continue;
635                                if (itemGenRandom.nextFloat() > p) continue;
636                                if (member.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.NO_SELL)) continue;
637                                if (!isMilitaryMarket() && member.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.MILITARY_MARKET_ONLY)) continue;
638                                
639                                picker.add(member, f);
640                        }
641                        
642                        List<FleetMemberAPI> members = new ArrayList<>();
643                        while (!picker.isEmpty()) {
644                                members.add(picker.pickAndRemove());
645                        }
646                        
647                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : members) {
648                                //if (itemGenRandom.nextFloat() > p) continue;
649//                              if (member.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.NO_SELL)) continue;
650//                              if (!isMilitaryMarket() && member.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.MILITARY_MARKET_ONLY)) continue;
651                                String emptyVariantId = member.getHullId() + "_Hull";
652                                addShip(emptyVariantId, true, params.qualityOverride);
653                        }
654                }
655        }

657        protected FleetMemberAPI addShip(String variantOrWingId, boolean withDmods, float quality) {
658                FleetMemberAPI member = null;
659                if (variantOrWingId.endsWith("_wing")) {
660                        member = Global.getFactory().createFleetMember(FleetMemberType.FIGHTER_WING, variantOrWingId);
661                } else {
662                        member = Global.getFactory().createFleetMember(FleetMemberType.SHIP, variantOrWingId);
663                }
664                
665                if (withDmods) {
666                        float averageDmods = DefaultFleetInflater.getAverageDmodsForQuality(quality);
667                        int addDmods = DefaultFleetInflater.getNumDModsToAdd(member.getVariant(), averageDmods, itemGenRandom);
668                        if (addDmods > 0) {
669                                DModManager.setDHull(member.getVariant());
670                                DModManager.addDMods(member, true, addDmods, itemGenRandom);
671                        }
672                }
673                
674                member.getRepairTracker().setMothballed(true);
675                member.getRepairTracker().setCR(0.5f);
676//              assignShipName(member, submarket.getFaction().getId());
677                getCargo().getMothballedShips().addFleetMember(member);
678                return member;
679        }

702        protected void addHullMods(int maxTier, int num, String factionId) {
703                //float p = Global.getSettings().getFloat("sellHullmodProb");
704                
705                num = getModifiedNum(num, false, "ext_hullmodForSaleFraction");
706                
707                CargoAPI cargo = getCargo();
708                for (CargoStackAPI stack : cargo.getStacksCopy()) {
709                        if (stack.isModSpecStack()) {
710                                cargo.removeStack(stack);
711                        }
712                }
713                
714                FactionAPI faction = null;
715                if (factionId != null) {
716                        faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(factionId);
717                }
718                
719                WeightedRandomPicker<HullModSpecAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<HullModSpecAPI>(itemGenRandom);
720                for (String id : submarket.getFaction().getKnownHullMods()) {
721                        //if (Global.getSector().getCharacterData().knowsHullMod(id)) continue;
722                        HullModSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getHullModSpec(id);
723                        if (spec.isHidden()) continue;
724                        if (spec.isAlwaysUnlocked()) continue;
725                        if (spec.getTier() > maxTier) continue;
726                        float p = spec.getRarity();
727                        if (faction != null && faction.getHullmodSellFrequency().containsKey(id) &&
728                                        !Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction().knowsHullMod(id)) {
729                                p *= faction.getHullmodSellFrequency().get(id);
730                        }
731//                      if (Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction().knowsHullMod(id)) {
732//                              p *= 0.25f;
733//                      }
734                                
735                        picker.add(spec, p);
736                }
737                //picker.getItems().contains("missile_autoloader");
738                for (int i = 0; i < num; i++) {
739                        HullModSpecAPI pick = picker.pickAndRemove();
740                        if (pick == null) continue;
741                        
742                        String id = pick.getId();
743                        if (cargoAlreadyHasMod(id)) continue;
744                        
745                        if (Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction().knowsHullMod(id)) continue;
746                        
747                        //cargo.addItems(CargoItemType.MOD_SPEC, id, 1);
748                        
749                        cargo.addItems(CargoItemType.SPECIAL, new SpecialItemData(Items.TAG_MODSPEC, id), 1);
750                }
751                
752        }

764        protected boolean cargoAlreadyHasMod(String id) {

768                        if (stack.isSpecialStack() && stack.getSpecialDataIfSpecial().getId().equals(Items.TAG_MODSPEC) &&
769                                        stack.getSpecialDataIfSpecial().getData().equals(id)) return true;
770                }
771                return false;
772        }

910        public static float getCommodityAvailabilityMult(MarketAPI market, SubmarketAPI submarket, String cid) {
911                
912//              if (cid.equals("supplies") && market.isPlayerOwned()) {
913//                      System.out.println("fwewfwefwefwe");
914//              }
915                
916                if (Misc.isExtended()) {
917                        String modId = "ext_" + cid + "ForSaleFraction";
918                        
919                        float mult = 1f;
920                        if (submarket != null && submarket.getPlugin() instanceof LocalResourcesSubmarketPlugin) {
921                                mult *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_localResourcesStockpileAndRateMult");
922                        }
923                        
924                        String modId3 = "ext_" + cid + "ForSaleMilitaryMult";
925                        if (Global.getSettings().hasKey(modId3) && submarket != null && submarket.getPlugin().isMilitaryMarket()) {
926                                mult *= Global.getSettings().optFloat(modId3, 1f);
927                        }
928                        
929                        if (market.isPlayerOwned()) {
930                                String modId2 = "ext_" + cid + "ForSaleFractionPlayerColony";
931                                if (Global.getSettings().hasKey(modId2)) {
932                                        return Global.getSettings().optFloat(modId2, 1f) * mult;
933                                }
934                        } else if (market.isFreePort() || 
935                                        (market.getFaction() != null && market.getFaction().getCustomBoolean(Factions.CUSTOM_ALLOWS_TRANSPONDER_OFF_TRADE))) {
936                                String modId2 = "ext_" + cid + "ForSaleFractionFreePort";
937                                if (Global.getSettings().hasKey(modId2)) {
938                                        return Global.getSettings().optFloat(modId2, 1f) * mult;
939                                }
940                        }
941                        
942                        if (submarket != null) {
943                                CommodityOnMarketAPI com = market.getCommodityData(cid);
944                                if (com.isPersonnel()) {
945                                        float rel = submarket.getFaction().getRelToPlayer().getRel();
946                                        if (rel < 0) {
947                                                mult *= 1f + (1f - Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_personnelForSaleMinMultBadRep")) * rel;
948                                        } else {
949                                                mult *= 1f + (Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_personnelForSaleMaxMultGoodRep") - 1f) * rel;
950                                        }
951                                        
952                                }
953                        }
954                        
955                        return Global.getSettings().optFloat(modId, 1f) * mult;
956                }
957                return 1f;
958        }

960        public void addAndRemoveStockpiledResources(CommodityOnMarketAPI com, float amount,
961                                                                                                boolean withShortageCountering,
962                                                                                                boolean withDecreaseToLimit,
963                                                                                                boolean withCargoUpdate) {
964                
965//              if (com.isIllegal() && com.getMarket().isPlayerOwned()) {
966//                      System.out.println("wefwefew");
967//              }
968                
969                float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
970                //if (days <= 0) return;
971                
972                if (com.isNonEcon()) return;
973                if (com.getCommodity().isMeta()) return;
974                //if (com.getMaxSupply() <= 0 && com.getMaxDemand() <= 0) return;
975                
976                CargoAPI cargo = getCargo();
977                //String modId = "localRes";
978//              String modId = submarket.getSpecId();
979//                      
980//              com.getAvailableStat().unmodifyFlat(modId);
981//              
982//              int demand = com.getMaxDemand();
983//              int available = com.getAvailable();
984                
985                
986                if (withShortageCountering) {
987                        withShortageCountering = market.isUseStockpilesForShortages();
988                }
989                
990                //if (demand > available && withShortageCountering) {
991                if (doShortageCountering(com, amount, withShortageCountering)) {
992                        return;
993                }
994                
995                float mult = getCommodityAvailabilityMult(market, submarket, com.getId());
996                //days *= mult;
997                
998                if (!shouldHaveCommodity(com)) {
999                        if (withDecreaseToLimit) {
1000                                float limit = getStockpileLimit(com) * mult;
1001                                float curr = cargo.getCommodityQuantity(com.getId());
1002                                if (curr > limit && withDecreaseToLimit) {
1003                                        float removeRate = (curr - limit) * 2f / 30f;
1004                                        float removeAmount = removeRate * days * mult;
1005                                        
1006                                        if (curr - removeAmount < limit) {
1007                                                removeAmount = curr - limit;
1008                                        }
1009                                        if (removeAmount > 0 && curr <= 1) {
1010                                                removeAmount = 1f;
1011                                        }
1012                                        
1013                                        if (removeAmount > 0) {
1014                                                cargo.removeCommodity(com.getId(), removeAmount);
1015                                                if (Commodities.SUPPLIES.equals(com.getId())) {
1016                                                        float partsFraction = getPartsGeneratedAsFractionOfSupplies();
1017                                                        cargo.removeCommodity(Commodities.PARTS, Math.max(1f, removeAmount * partsFraction));
1018                                                }
1019                                        }
1020                                }
1021                        }
1022                        return;
1023                }
1024
1025                // add stockpile, up to limit
1026                float limit = getStockpileLimit(com) * mult;
1027                float curr = cargo.getCommodityQuantity(com.getId());
1028                
1029//              if (this instanceof LocalResourcesSubmarketPlugin) {
1030//                      cargo.removeCommodity(com.getId(), cargo.getCommodityQuantity(com.getId()));
1031//                      cargo.addCommodity(com.getId(), limit);
1032//                      return;
1033//              }
1034                
1035//              if (com.getId().equals(Commodities.SUPPLIES) && market.getId().equals("chicomoztoc")) {
1036//                      System.out.println("efkjwefew");
1037//              }
1038//              if (com.getId().equals(Commodities.SUPPLIES) && market.isPlayerOwned() && this instanceof LocalResourcesSubmarketPlugin) {
1039//                      System.out.println("efkjwefew");
1040//              }
1041                
1042                // deal with Domain-grade Parts
1043                if (Commodities.SUPPLIES.equals(com.getId())) {
1044//                      if (com.getMarket().isPlayerOwned() && this instanceof LocalResourcesSubmarketPlugin) {
1045//                              System.out.println("wefwefew");
1046//                      }
1047                        
1048//                      if (com.getMarket().isPlayerOwned() && this instanceof LocalResourcesSubmarketPlugin && 
1049//                                      com.getMarket().getName().equals("Ghant")) {
1050//                              System.out.println("wefwefew");
1051//                      }                       
1052                        
1053                        float partsFraction = getPartsGeneratedAsFractionOfSupplies();
1054                        if (partsFraction > 0) {
1055                                float partsLimit = limit * partsFraction;
1056                                float currParts = cargo.getCommodityQuantity(Commodities.PARTS);
1057                                
1058                                if (currParts < partsLimit && withCargoUpdate) {
1059                                        float addRate = limit / 30f * getStockpilingAddRateMult(com);
1060                                        float addAmount = addRate * days * partsFraction;
1061                                        if (currParts + addAmount > partsLimit) {
1062                                                addAmount = partsLimit - currParts;
1063                                        }
1064                                        if (addAmount > 0) {
1065                                                float q = cargo.getCommodityQuantity(Commodities.PARTS) + addAmount;
1066                                                if (q < 1) {
1067                                                        addAmount = 1f; // add at least 1 unit or it won't do anything
1068                                                }
1069                                                cargo.addCommodity(Commodities.PARTS, addAmount);
1070                                        }
1071                                }
1072                                if (currParts > partsLimit && withDecreaseToLimit) {
1073                                        float removeRate = (currParts - partsLimit) * 2f / 30f;
1074                                        float removeAmount = removeRate * days * mult;
1075                                                
1076                                        if (currParts - removeAmount < partsLimit) {
1077                                                removeAmount = currParts - partsLimit;
1078                                        }
1079                                        if (removeAmount > 0 && currParts <= 1) {
1080                                                removeAmount = 1f;
1081                                        }
1082                                        if (removeAmount > 0) {
1083                                                cargo.removeCommodity(Commodities.PARTS, removeAmount);
1084                                        }
1085                                }
1086                        }
1087                }
1088                
1089                
1090                
1091                if (curr < limit && withCargoUpdate) {
1092                        if (limit <= 0) return;
1093                        
1094//                      if (market.isPlayerOwned() && market.getName().startsWith("Dark")) {
1095//                              System.out.println("wefwef" + market.getName());
1096//                      }
1097                        
1098                        float addRate = limit / 30f * getStockpilingAddRateMult(com);
1099                        
1100                        // make it so the player constantly re-checking doesn't keep adding cargo more quickly than it should,
1101                        // due to having to add at least 1 unit if there's nothing 
1102                        if (sinceLastCargoUpdate * addRate + curr < 1) {
1103                                return;
1104                        }
1105                        
1106//                      if (Commodities.SUPPLIES.equals(com.getId())) {
1107//                              if (com.getMarket().isPlayerOwned() && this instanceof LocalResourcesSubmarketPlugin) {
1108//                                      System.out.println("wefwefew123");
1109//                              }
1110//                      }
1111                        
1112                        float addAmount = addRate * days;
1113                                
1114                        
1115                        if (curr + addAmount > limit) {
1116                                addAmount = limit - curr;
1117                        }
1118                        
1119                        if (addAmount > 0) {
1120                                float q = cargo.getCommodityQuantity(com.getId()) + addAmount;
1121                                if (q < 1) {
1122                                        if (Misc.isExtended() && com.isPersonnel()) {
1123                                                if (itemGenRandom.nextFloat() < q) {
1124                                                        addAmount = 1f;
1125                                                } else {
1126                                                        addAmount = 0f;
1127                                                }
1128                                        } else {
1129                                                addAmount = 1f; // add at least 1 unit or it won't do anything
1130                                        }
1131                                }
1132                                
1133                                cargo.addCommodity(com.getId(), addAmount);
1134                        }
1135                        
1136                        return;
1137                }
1138                
1139                //withDecreaseToLimit = true;
1140                if (curr > limit && withDecreaseToLimit) {
1141                        float removeRate = (curr - limit) * 2f / 30f;
1142                        float removeAmount = removeRate * days * mult;
1143                        
1144                        if (curr - removeAmount < limit) {
1145                                removeAmount = curr - limit;
1146                        }
1147                        if (removeAmount > 0 && curr <= 1) {
1148                                removeAmount = 1f;
1149                        }
1150                        
1151//                      if (true) {
1152//                              removeAmount = curr - limit;
1153//                      }
1154                        
1155                        if (removeAmount > 0) {
1156                                cargo.removeCommodity(com.getId(), removeAmount);
1157                        }
1158                        return;
1159                }
1160        }

1163        protected float getPartsGeneratedAsFractionOfSupplies() {
1164                if (!Misc.usePartsBasedDModRepairs()) return 0f;
1165                
1166                float quality = market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.PRODUCTION_QUALITY_MOD).computeEffective(0f);
1167                quality += 0.3f;
1168                float prod = 0f;
1169                CommodityOnMarketAPI com = market.getCommodityData(Commodities.SUPPLIES);
1170                if (com != null) prod = com.getMaxSupply();
1171                
1172                float mult = Misc.isExtended() ? Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_partsForSaleFraction") : 1f;
1173                
1174                float fBase = Global.getSettings().getFloat("partsForSaleBaseSuppliesFraction");
1175                float fProd = Global.getSettings().getFloat("partsForSaleBaseProductionFraction");
1176                
1177                return (fBase + quality * fProd * Math.min(1.5f, prod/10f)) * mult;
1178        }
